summary: Yamtrack is a self-hosted platform designed to help you organise and monitor your consumption of various media formats, including films, television series, anime, manga, video games and books. It provides a centralised dashboard to track your progress and manage your personal entertainment library. The project is distributed under the AGPL-3.0 licence and is written in Python.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you want to consolidate multiple tracking lists for different media types into a single self-hosted database rather than relying on separate third-party services.
watchOut: The project is still maturing and has a relatively small community compared to established alternatives, which may mean fewer integrations and slower troubleshooting for edge cases.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based application, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your data and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
